chapter: Kansas City, Omaha and Lloyd Hunter
title: Back to drums; Debo Mills leaves for Horace Henderson
summary: After under a year and a half Hunter found a new bassist, Gus returned to drums, and Debo Mills left for Horace Henderson in New York.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Well, how long did you -- how are we doing? We've got quite a while. So what time did you put in with the band, about a year and a half?
Not quite a year and a half.
You just felt you couldn't take it, huh?
Yeah, I wanted to play my drums anyway.
Oh, yes, of course, sure.
I was playing the bass.
Sure.
And so he finally found out that I liked my drums.
Yeah.
So he got a bass player. Debo left, Debo Mills left.
Oh, yeah.
He left and went and joined Horace Henderson.
Did he? Oh, yes, you said that, didn't you? Yes.
And --
Horace really -- that was a territory
Yeah, but he was in New York.
Oh.
See, Horace was in New York when Debo joined him.
But he kept going on the road.
Oh, yes, sure, that's right, sure.
